name: Takagi Aki
source: One of [url=/c22265]Mariko's[/url] underlings who is very rude. She wishes to become number one in her class so she could be like Mariko; in reality, she wants to replace Mariko because she actually looks down on her, and acts like one of her underlings in order to take her out.
translation: [url=/c22265]真理子[/url]的手下之一，态度非常无礼。她希望成为班级第一，这样就能像真理子一样；实际上她想取代真理子，因为她打心底看不起对方，只是装作手下，等待除掉她的机会。
